sentences.en: The musician began to play the violin on the stage.
sentences.zh: 这位音乐家开始在舞台上拉小提琴。

sentences.en: The musician is famous abroad as well as in Japan.
sentences.zh: 这位音乐家不仅在日本，在国外也很有名。

sentences.en: They say he was a musician when he was young.
sentences.zh: 据说他年轻时是一名音乐家。

senses.zh: 音乐家 形容词: musicianly
